Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows right lung volume loss and a kinked vessel, which, combined with the specific absence of the right upper lobe bronchus and vein, is characteristic of pulmonary hypoplasia (or agenesis) of the right upper lobe. This congenital anomaly explains the structural deficits and compensatory vascular changes better than acquired conditions like atelectasis or Swyer-James syndrome.
